registered: 2026-11-19 ~04:35 ET, before any event was built or scored
operator: 11/18-19: '%R secondary, a primary driver for opens' -> Argon's list checked against prior studies -> 'Yes, test the board-wide buying wave tonight' / 'why not run it now?'
idea: Losers fire alone while the board is flat; a real risk-on wave lifts many board names at once. PRIMARY = a board-wide buying wave; SECONDARY = the name's %R trigger inside the wave; only names the desk could trade (spread <= 6 bp, the live gate).
board: each minute t, the warehouse top-400 names in the admission band ($20-$400, up >= 1.5% vs prior close at t)
wave: minute t is a wave minute if the board has >= 10 names and >= 35% of them made a new 5-minute high (high > max of the previous 5 highs) at t or t-1; a wave stays active for minutes t..t+2
entries: a board name's %R trigger at a minute when a wave is active, minutes 15-330; per name and mode the next entry at least 16 minutes after the previous one (the desk exit's 15-minute horizon); enter at the next minute's open

timing_modes.loose: fast %R (21, EWM 7) >= -50 and rising this bar

exits.desk: holistic_entry bracket gross (+20 bp before -50 bp within 15 min)
exits.atr: catalyst_primary.vol_exit (2 ATR stop / 4 ATR target / 60 min)

cost: real SIP quoted spread in the 60 s before entry (news_source.fetch_quotes); entries with spread > 6 bp are not traded (the desk's live gate) and are dropped; net = gross - spread
sample: <= 4,000 entries per (mode, period) by the lowest sha256('breadth'|day|sym|t); both exits are scored on the same entries

pass_each (4 cells: 2 timing modes x 2 e.both_halves: mean net > 0 in both halves of the days

information_only: the same names' %R triggers OUTSIDE waves (does the wave add anything? lift = wave - non-wave); 9/24-11/17; time-of-day buckets; opens per 10 minutes; median spread; share of entries removed by the 6 bp gate
if_pass: result-skeptic review, then a paper lane behind a default-off switch, replayed through the live code, then on under the operator's 11/18 rule
if_fail: record; board-wave primary closed at these settings
